notes: The wiring is old surface wiring with loose, taped joints. One round 3-pin socket shows burn marks, a fire risk the underwriter should flag.
The MCB box is dated 2014 (Havells Eurobreaker, 2 x B25).
The wall-mounted fibre router is probably owned by the ISP, not the occupant.
No ceiling fan or light fitting was photographed; the ceiling was not captured. Ask the owner whether a fan and tube light exist.
A mattress under the bedcover was not confirmed. The box bed may have a thin mattress; ask the owner.
The books are worn paperbacks and at least one has a second-hand price sticker. RCV is the new price.
No bookshelves were seen. The books stand on the desk. The almirah interior was not photographed.
The monitor model and resolution were not read. It was priced as the closest Acer Nitro 24 inch FHD.
The laptop was priced as the current Victus 15 Ryzen 5 / RTX 3050. The exact SKU should come from the bottom label or invoice.
Floor area was estimated from the 190 x 120 cm bed, the 0.9 m almirah and the desk footprint: about 3.3 x 3.3 m.
